title: nb.data_transform_recipe, version 1
description: One line of the file NB_DT_RECIPES names: one product of a ciphertext by a diagonal set (linear_transform, or one set of linear_transforms), appended when the product runs. See dsl_fhe/docs/RUN_METADATA.md.

version.description: The schema's version. A consumer rejects a version it does not know.

product.description: The product's number in this process, from 0, in the order the products run; one more on every line of a run.

diagonals.description: The number of diagonals in the set (its outer length).

level.description: The level every diagonal of the product is encoded at (MakeCKKSPackedPlaintext's level argument).

slots.description: The slot count every diagonal is encoded with.

noise_scale_deg.description: The noise scale degree every diagonal is encoded with: always 1.

recipe.description: How the diagonals are built from a matrix, or null: the set was built another way (or changed after bsgs_diagonals returned it), and only its values describe it.

kind.description: The builtin that built the set.

set.description: The set's number in this process, from 0, in the order bsgs_diagonals returned the sets. Products of the same set share it.

file.description: The path load_matrix read the matrix w from, as the program spelled it (relative paths are relative to the run's working directory); null when w is not a loaded matrix, or was changed after it was loaded.

cols.description: The matrix's column count (the record length load_matrix was given; the first row's length when w is not a loaded matrix).

digest.description: The 64-bit digest of the matrix's values (dsl_fhe/docs/RUN_METADATA.md, 'Matrix digest'), 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

row0.description: bsgs_diagonals' row0: the submatrix's first row.

col0.description: bsgs_diagonals' col0: the submatrix's first column.

width.description: bsgs_diagonals' width: the submatrix is width x width.

count.description: bsgs_diagonals' count: the number of diagonals built.

bstep.description: bsgs_diagonals' bstep: the baby step; diagonal k is counter-rotated by bstep * (k / bstep).

region.description: bsgs_diagonals' region: the slot distance between two regions.

length.description: bsgs_diagonals' length: the slot count of every diagonal vector.

r_lo.description: bsgs_diagonals' r_lo: the first region filled.

r_hi.description: bsgs_diagonals' r_hi: the last region filled (inclusive).

scale.description: bsgs_diagonals' s: the factor every matrix element is multiplied by. Printed with 17 significant digits: it reads back to the same float64.
